# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are prepared for the latest stable release. Older releases are not guaranteed to receive updates; upgrade to the latest stable release before reporting an issue.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Use [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/apimgr/timezones/security/advisories/new) as the primary reporting channel. Do not file vulnerabilities in public issues. On repository mirrors without private vulnerability reporting, report through the GitHub origin repository.

Maintainers will acknowledge reports, assess their impact, coordinate remediation and disclosure with the reporter, and publish an advisory when affected users can update. Response and remediation timing depends on severity and the work required; no fixed response-time commitment is offered.

For deployed-instance reporting details, see the `/.well-known/security.txt` endpoint provided by the deployment and the [security documentation](https://apimgr-timezones.readthedocs.io/en/latest/security/).
